assistworld-assist-world:lever:76b9ecdf-.title: Backlink Outreach / Link-Building Specialist
assistworld-assist-world:lever:76b9ecdf-.description: We’re looking for a Backlink Outreach / Link-Building Specialist to help grow our website’s authority through high-quality backlink acquisition and editorial outreach. Your primary responsibility will be to secure relevant, authoritative placements and grow the number of high-quality referring domains through channels such as HARO/Qwoted, podcasts, guest posts, and other editorial opportunities. This is a results-driven role . We care about the quality and impact of the placements you secure — not simply how many pitches you send. What You’ll Do Identify relevant, authoritative websites and media opportunities for backlink acquisition. Conduct targeted outreach to secure editorial placements. Pursue opportunities through HARO/Qwoted, podcasts, guest posts, and similar channels . Build and manage relationships with relevant outlets and publishers. Manage opportunities from initial outreach through to confirmed placement. Maintain an active pipeline of upcoming backlink and editorial opportunities. Track placements and referring-domain growth using Semrush . Monitor backlink quality and flag potentially spammy, low-authority, or paid-placement-heavy opportunities. Provide a concise weekly report covering: Placements landed Placements currently in progress New referring domains Any red flags or issues Your target outlets/sites for the following week How You’ll Be Measured Your performance will be evaluated against four core KPIs: New Referring Domains 15–25 new referring domains per month Dofollow, Editorial-Relevant Links 70%+ of new links Authority Score Trend +0.5–1.0 average monthly increase Placements Landed 4–8 placements per month These KPIs are designed to measure actual results , rather than activity. Metrics such as total backlinks, pitches sent, or emails opened are not considered success metrics. AI search citations will also be tracked separately through monthly spot-checks of priority queries. What Success Looks Like You’ll thrive in this role if you can consistently: Secure genuine editorial placements on relevant websites. Grow the number of high-quality referring domains. Maintain a strong percentage of dofollow, editorially relevant links. Build a healthy pipeline of future placement opportunities. Contribute to consistent growth in Authority Score. Recognize and avoid low-quality or spammy backlink opportunities. Take ownership of your outreach pipeline and results. If you have a strong background in backlink outreach, link building, digital PR, editorial outreach, or securing earned media placements and are motivated by measurable results, we’d love to hear from you. Why Join Assist World? 100% REMOTE $50 birthday bonus $200 testimonial bonus NO TRACKER. NO PROBLEM

assistworld-assist-world:lever:b8538a05-.title: Customer Experience & Operations Coordinator | E-Commerce Industry
assistworld-assist-world:lever:b8538a05-.description: About the Role We're looking for a proactive, highly organized Customer Experience & Operations Coordinator to become a key member of our growing e-commerce team. This role combines customer experience, operations, logistics coordination, and project management to ensure our customers receive exceptional service while internal processes run smoothly. As a lean and fast-moving business, we need someone who can wear multiple hats, think strategically, and take ownership of issues before they become problems. You'll act as the bridge between customers, inventory, warehousing, logistics, and leadership—ensuring that information flows seamlessly and nothing falls through the cracks. This is not a traditional customer service role. While customer communication remains important, we're looking for someone who can proactively identify issues, coordinate solutions, and support operational excellence across the business. What You'll Do Customer Experience & Communications ● Deliver exceptional customer support across email, SMS, and other customer-facing channels. ● Respond to customer enquiries with professionalism, empathy, and attention to detail. ● Communicate order updates, delays, inventory issues, and resolutions clearly and proactively. ● Maintain a polished and professional communication style, ensuring all customer interactions reflect the brand. Logistics & Operations Coordination ● Monitor order fulfilment and shipping progress across the supply chain. ● Proactively investigate delayed, missing, or problematic orders. ● Liaise with warehouses, suppliers, and logistics partners to obtain updates and resolve issues. ● Identify and escalate inventory discrepancies, stock shortages, overselling concerns, and fulfilment bottlenecks. ● Serve as the operational link between customer-facing activities and backend business functions. Inventory & E-commerce Operations ● Monitor inventory levels and flag low-stock or at-risk products. ● Assist with inventory planning and re-order coordination. ● Support Shopify operations, including: ○ Product creation and updates. ○ Product descriptions and merchandising. ○ Seasonal merchandising and promotional updates. ○ Basic website and landing page maintenance. ● Ensure product information, inventory status, and customer-facing messaging remain accurate and up to date. Project Management & Process Improvement ● Own follow-ups and ensure action items are completed across teams. ● Track ongoing projects and operational priorities. ● Surface risks, blockers, and opportunities before they impact customers. ● Help build and improve systems, processes, and workflows as the business grows. ● Maintain clear reporting and visibility on operational performance and key priorities. Founder & Team Support ● Assist leadership with operational initiatives and special projects. ● Organize information and ensure priorities remain aligned. ● Support cross-functional communication between customer service, operations, marketing, and leadership. ● Provide recommendations and insights based on recurring customer and operational trends. ● Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset. Highly Desirable ● Experience working with inventory management, fulfilment, logistics, or supply chain operations. ● Previous experience supporting a founder-led or entrepreneurial business. ● Experience running a business, side hustle, or entrepreneurial venture. ● Familiarity with Shopify, Google Workspace, Slack, Trello, Asana, or similar tools. ● Experience creating reports, dashboards, and operational performance summaries. What We're Looking For Required Skills & Experience ● 3+ years of experience in customer operations, e-commerce operations, project coordination, account management, or a similar role. ● Experience working within a fast-paced e-commerce or direct-to-consumer (DTC) business. ● Strong understanding of Shopify and e-commerce operations. ● Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. ● Prove

jobgether-jobgether:lever:19a09a0f-cf14-.title: Direct Import Operations Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:19a09a0f-cf14-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Direct Import Operations Coordinator based in the United States. This role is focused on coordinating day-to-day international import operations within a fast-paced eCommerce and retail environment. You will manage shipment readiness, bookings, documentation, and milestone tracking across a complex network of global partners. The position requires close coordination with factories, freight forwarders, customer traffic teams, and third-party logistics providers. You’ll play a key role in keeping shipments on schedule and identifying risks before they affect customers or operations. Success requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and confident follow-up across multiple stakeholders and time zones. The role is particularly well suited to someone who thrives in high-volume environments and enjoys keeping complex logistics processes moving smoothly. Monitor open purchase orders, shipment readiness, cargo-ready dates, and planned ship dates to ensure import activities remain on schedule. Coordinate shipment bookings with factories and freight forwarders, ensuring bookings are secured within required customer shipping windows. Follow up on booking confirmations, vessel allocations, shipment milestones, and potential capacity constraints. Review and process factory documentation, ensuring import and shipping paperwork is accurate, complete, and delivered on time. Generate customer shipping document packets and upload or distribute them through customer portals and traffic-team channels. Receive inventory into the relevant ERP system and assemble invoice-supporting documentation before or immediately after shipment departure. Maintain shipment logs and accurately report key milestones throughout the import lifecycle. Coordinate with at least five parties per shipment, maintaining proactive communication and strong follow-up across factories, freight forwarders, customers, and other logistics partners. Identify and promptly escalate delays, missing information, documentation issues, booking problems, and other exceptions that could impact shipment performance. Support high-volume peak-season operations involving 100+ active purchase orders or individual containerized shipments. Contribute to improved booking performance, documentation accuracy, milestone visibility, and reduced administrative workload for operations teams. Requirements 2–5 years of professional experience in international import operations, supply chain coordination, or a closely related field. Hands-on experience with international logistics, including FOB shipments, import/export documentation, customs requirements, and global shipping procedures. Experience supporting U.S. retail import programs, ideally involving major retailers such as Costco, Walmart/Sam’s Club, Target, Amazon, Home Depot, Lowe’s, or similar organizations. General ERP proficiency, with experience using Microsoft Dynamics NAV or Business Central 365 preferred; candidates without this specific system experience can be trained. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word. Familiarity with global import documentation processes and the creation, review, and distribution of shipping documents. Ability to communicate firmly and professionally with factories, freight forwarders, agents, and other external partners. Comfortable coordinating across multiple time zones and working closely with U.S.-based teams. Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and follow-through, particularly when managing numerous concurrent shipments. Ability to identify exceptions quickly, assess potential operational impact, and escalate issues appropriately. Preferred experience includes working with international 3PL warehouse facilities, factories in Asia such as China, Vietnam, or Cambodia, and freight-forwarder platforms such as E

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8422a761-755f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Manager – Brand & Organic Growth based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to become a highly visible voice for a growing portfolio of digital brands within the iGaming and affiliate marketing space. You will shape brand presence across industry events, conferences, social media, and digital channels. The position combines relationship building, content creation, event marketing, and organic growth initiatives. You will build meaningful connections with industry stakeholders, media, partners, and other influential contacts. Working closely with SEO, content, and affiliate teams, you will turn events and social activity into measurable brand visibility and organic reach. This is a dynamic role for a charismatic marketer who enjoys representing brands publicly and creating opportunities for recognition and growth. Represent the brands at industry events, expos, conferences, networking opportunities, and other relevant gatherings, acting as a confident and engaging public representative. Create original and engaging content, including photos, videos, interviews, stories, and industry insights, to capture event experiences and strengthen digital presence. Plan and publish event-related and industry-focused content across relevant social media platforms to increase engagement and visibility. Build relationships with industry stakeholders, media contacts, partners, and influencers to generate organic mentions, backlinks, social shares, and other brand amplification opportunities. Collaborate with SEO, content, affiliate, and other internal teams to maximize the impact of social media, events, and brand-building initiatives. Proactively identify and pursue speaking engagements, panel discussions, interviews, media opportunities, and other activities that can strengthen brand credibility and industry recognition. Monitor and analyze the performance of social and event initiatives, using insights to improve brand visibility, organic growth, and audience engagement. Stay informed about industry developments, emerging trends, and relevant opportunities that can contribute to stronger brand positioning and organic reach. Requirements 2–5 years of demonstrated marketing experience within the iGaming industry, particularly in roles involving public representation, social media, event marketing, or brand growth. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the charisma and confidence to act as a visible representative at industry events and across digital channels. Proven ability to build and maintain authentic professional relationships and develop a strong industry network organically. Comfortable independently producing engaging social media content, including event coverage, interviews, photos, videos, and short-form stories. Good understanding of digital marketing and fundamental SEO concepts, particularly the role of organic visibility in building brand awareness and authority. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities independently while maintaining a high standard of execution. Willingness and ability to travel frequently for conferences, expos, networking events, and other industry activities. Fluent English communication skills; additional languages are considered an advantage. A proactive, adaptable, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities and turn relationships and industry activity into measurable brand impact. Benefits Competitive salary with performance-related bonuses. Additional “refer a friend” bonus opportunities. Diverse career development and growth opportunities. Supportive and collaborative working environment. Flexible work arrangements designed to support work-life balance. Corporate events and opportunities to participate in industry activities. Corporate travel opportunities. Advanced benefits
